description: Young men and women in white shirts, dhotis and saris march arm in arm down a brick street in low sunlight. A large black banner and several placards above them carry clearly legible Bengali script. Uniformed police with rifles stand at the sides and far end. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge, no border.
reason: The black banner and the placards (and some shop signs) carry painted Bengali lettering, which breaks the no-text rule. Regenerate with blank placards and no legible script.
